title: Gemini CLI vs Antigravity: Real-World Performance
excerpt: The AI coding tool wars have shifted from spec sheets to real-world testing. This week we examine Gemini CLI and Antigravity's actual performance in production environments, cutting through marketing noise to show security-conscious teams what really works.
